trans.sense: clothes for wearing to bed and sleeping in

examples.text: She put on a coat over her new pair of pajamas.

glosses: Clothes for wearing to bed and sleeping in, usually consisting of a loose-fitting shirt and pants/trousers.
Loose-fitting trousers worn by both sexes in various southern Asian countries including India.

raw_glosses: (cricket, slang) The coloured uniform worn by players in professional limited overs matches.
